WEATHER FORECAST FOR 08 August 2026
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 07 August 2026
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, and North-western
provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Cloudy skies will prevail over
these areas.
Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy and
Nuwara-Eliya districts.
Strong winds of about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over North-central, Sabaragamuwa,
Southern, Central and North-western provinces.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
Rainfall amount (mm): Light: 00-12.5, Light to moderate: 12.5-25, Moderate: 25-50, Fairly heavy rain: 50 -100,
Heavy rain: 100 – 150, Very heavy rain: 150 or more.

WEATHER FORECAST FOR SEA AREAS AROUND THE ISLAND DURING NEXT 24 HOURS
Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 07 August 2026
Condition of Rain:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Matara via Colombo and Galle.
Winds:
Winds will be westerly to south-westerly. Wind speed will be (30-40) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to (60-70) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kalpitiya to Colombo and from Matara to Pottuvil via Hambantota.
Wind speed can increase up to (50-60) kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Batticaloa to Kalpitiya via Trincomalee, Kankasanthurai and Mannar and from Colombo to Matara
via Galle.
State of Sea:
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Kalpitiya to Colombo and from Matara to Pottuvil via
Hambantota will be rough or very rough at times. Naval and fishing communities are advised not to
venture into these sea areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from Batticaloa to Kalpitiya via Trincomalee, Kankasanthurai
and Mannar and from, Colombo to Matara via Galle will be rough at times. The naval and fishing

to be vigilant in this regard.
The wave height may increase about (2.5 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
